context_notes: Paused with the loan log half moved over. The migration is applied to the dev copy only, so the dev copy and the committed schema agree but the loan log does not read the new column yet. I was part way through deciding whether the name snapshot should also carry the member's shed, and leaned towards no: the log already shows the shed from the loan row, and a second copy would drift. The tests for the log pin the old join, so expect three red tests until the read moves; they are the right red, not a regression. After the read moves, the signed-in list is the next piece and it needs the staging session service, which is why the first pending human action is marked blocking. Keep the cut-off wording for last: it is the one thing the steward group has asked to see before it ships.
